notes: The tool reads the app's files (config/app.json, data/tmf.sqlite, data/launcher.log, data/debug/, run.dist/RELEASE.json) and its MQTT topics; it never imports the app.
A framework version newer than max_tested is still served: unknown fields are ignored and missing data degrades to fewer features, never to wrong data.
Builds older than 1.30 have no in-app flight recorder; the tool records from MQTT itself (own mode).
Builds older than 1.32 export bundles without system/*, install/integrity or instrument events; the collect kit fills the system facts in itself.
